productRule: If a supported chef or restaurant operator must manually leave ChefFlow to perform a normal internal operating task, that workflow is incomplete.

stateDefinitions.partial: Some of the workflow exists, but the operator cannot reliably finish the full job inside ChefFlow.
stateDefinitions.functional: The operator can perform the core task in ChefFlow, but end-to-end propagation, audit proof, or failure recovery is not yet verified.
stateDefinitions.closed_loop_verified: The task starts and finishes in ChefFlow, propagates to every required downstream system, preserves an audit trail, handles failure honestly, and has current verification evidence.
